title: 有馬記念の後に・吹き続け、どこまでも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr and Tokai Teio both lose the Arima Kinen! Though frustrated by their results, they appreciate the challenge the race provided.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They gave it their all and still couldn't win—but continuing to take on such tough challenges will eventually propel them to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both decide to keep on running—without ever giving up—so that one day, they can become their ideal selves.
